verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents official OpenFeature providers for several of its SDKs and says they can be used in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK. That lets flag code target the vendor-neutral OpenFeature API instead of LaunchDarkly's SDK API. The evidence is a short first-party docs mention, and "several" implies not every SDK is covered. missing for 10: list of supported languages/SDKs, details of feature parity between providers and native SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs... You can use these providers in your application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK.
